arrow_turret.name: Arrow Turret
arrow_turret.description: The arrow turret is a sturdy and well versitile turret that shoots individual arrows at enemies.
arrow_turret.levelTwo: Arrows that are fired from the turret track enemies so they never miss.

mini_sentry_turret.name: Mini Sentry Turret
mini_sentry_turret.description: A rapid fire turret that doesn't need to reload. Overall good for standing groud.
mini_sentry_turret.levelTwo: Decreases the time it takes each shot after a kill, but goes away quickly if no enemies are killed.
mini_sentry_turret.levelThree: After not taking damage for a certain time, slowly repair any lost armor.

railgun_turret.name: Railgun Turret
railgun_turret.description: Fires a strong piercing projectile with high damage and range, but high reload time.
railgun_turret.levelThree: When attacked, decrease reload time by .4s for the current reload

energizer_turret.name: Energizer Turret
energizer_turret.description: Buffs the damage, range, reload time, and projectile speed of a certain amount of turrets in range.
energizer_turret.levelTwo: When energizing a turret, it has a chance to energize another turret anywhere on the map without taking a energized slot.
energizer_turret.levelThree: When a turret dies while energized, it explodes for massive damage.

royal_turret.name: Royal Turret
royal_turret.description: Creates 3 knights that attack enemies too close to the king.
royal_turret.levelThree: When a knight or archer defeats an enemy, heal for some health.

flame_turret.name: Flame Turret
flame_turret.description: Uses a flamethrower to [color=orange]ignite[/color] enemies and burn them slowly.
flame_turret.levelTwo: Enemies that die ignited, [color=orange]ignite[/color] other enemies nearby.
flame_turret.levelThree: When an enemy dies that this turret ignited, gain armor.

firework_turret.name: Firework Turret
firework_turret.description: Launches a 3 burst of fireworks in a quick succession that do area damage.
firework_turret.levelThree: Enemies that die to the firework explosion half the reload time of the next firework.

reaper_turret.name: Reaper Turret
reaper_turret.description: Launches scythes that have a chance to [color=black]execute[/color] enemies.
reaper_turret.levelTwo: For every enemy hit that wasn't executed, increase the [color=black]execute[/color] chance.
reaper_turret.levelThree: Reaper turret can now [color=black]execute[/color] bosses, but the chance is halved.

spider_turret.name: Spider Turret
spider_turret.description: Shoots darts that have a chance to [color=green]poison[/color] enemies.
spider_turret.levelTwo: Darts have a chance to trap enemies in a web and stun them.
spider_turret.levelThree: Enemies caught in the web are now poisoned, if an enemy was poisoned before the web, extend the poison time.

tesla_turret.name: Tesla Turret
tesla_turret.description: Builds up charge then shocks all enemies around it for high damage.
tesla_turret.levelTwo: Enemies hit by the tesla turret are stunned slightly.
tesla_turret.levelThree: Electricity now chains to nearby enemies that aren't in range

seismic_turret.name: Seismic Turret
seismic_turret.description: Rumbles the ground with a shockwave, destroying all enemies in a close range.
seismic_turret.levelTwo: While the turret is reloading, it creates a mini shockwave that continuously does damage.
seismic_turret.levelThree: When an enemy is killed my a shockwave, it creates another shockwave that chains to other enemies.

gold_mine_turret.name: Gold Mine Turret
gold_mine_turret.description: Generates you money over time, killing an enemy speeds up this generation time.
gold_mine_turret.levelTwo: When this turret kills an enemy, get triple the money you would usually get.
gold_mine_turret.levelThree: When this turret generates money, it has a chance to double the amount.

sentry_turret.name: Sentry Turret
sentry_turret.description: Mass fire bullets but there's a long reload time and it's not very accurate.
sentry_turret.levelTwo: While firing, regenerate a small amount of ammo.
sentry_turret.levelThree: While not firing, regenerate a small amount of ammo.

voodoo_turret.name: Voodoo Turret
voodoo_turret.description: Throws a voodoo doll that has a chance to [color=magenta]curse[/color] enemies.
voodoo_turret.levelTwo: When a cursed enemy dies, [color=magenta]curse[/color] all enemies around them.
voodoo_turret.levelThree: Enemies cursed by this turret now do 30% less damage.

zombie_turret.name: Zombie Turret
zombie_turret.description: Has a chance every few seconds to [color=olive]zombify[/color] enemies in range.
zombie_turret.levelTwo: While zombies rot, they have a chance to heal the zombie turret.
zombie_turret.levelThree: Zombies now activley hunt down enemies to attempt to [color=olive]zombify[/color] them

medic_turret.name: Medic Turret
medic_turret.description: Heals all turrets in range periodically.

bubble_turret.name: Bubble Turret
bubble_turret.description: Doesn't attack, gives all turrets in range a bubble that reflects projectiles until it pops!

boomerang_turret.name: Boomerang Turret
boomerang_turret.description: Throws a boomerang that pierces multiple enemies
